Title: Escape Tsunami Save Brainrot
Description: An incredible threat is looming over the city — a giant wave created by alien technologies is rapidly approaching! Only you can save the unique Brainroth creatures before they are overwhelmed by an alien tsunami. Grab them, rush away from the impending disaster and manage to deliver them to a safe zone. Upgrade your mobility — increase your speed, agility and endurance to get further away from the wave and save more creatures. 🧠 Search and collect — from the most common to the legendary brainrots, each of which has unique features and value. 🏠 Create a rescue base — take brainrots to the shelter, replenish the collection, unlock new abilities and upgrade the shelter. Become a master of escape — use strategy, quick reactions and ingenuity to outrun the alien threat. Can you outrun the UFO tsunami, save all the brainrots and become the legend of the base? Run, collect and survive — the challenge has already begun! 🛸🔥
Instructions: On the Computer: WASD- move. PCM - look around. The space bar is a jump. On the phone: The joystick is moving. There is a jump button at the bottom right.

Title: Obby Space Challenge: Starships
Description:
Obby Space Challenge: Starships is an exciting game where you get to fly starships. Collect energy capsules, earn trophies for your flights, and unlock new starships. Build a collection of the best companions, acquire the ultimate ship, and set out to explore all the locations in this cosmic world!

• Collect energy capsules!
• Earn trophies for your flights!
• Acquire companions!
• Switch starships!
• Unlock new locations!

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?

A: The game is about collecting capsules and flying a spaceship to earn trophy points.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?

A: The game offers a variety of pet and spaceship skins, great graphics, an achievement system, and tasks to engage players.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: The more energy the character collects, the more trophies they will receive after the flight.

Economy & Customization

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: The game features energy and trophies as currencies. Trophies can be used to purchase pets and spaceships to speed up energy acquisition.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?

A: Yes, the game offers many pet and spaceship skins that come with enhancements.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar to incentivize players to return?

A: Yes, the game offers rewards that players receive based on their time spent in the game. Rewards are refreshed daily.

Q: Is it advisable to play with sound to better immerse oneself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in playing without sound?

A: Music complements the game, but it is not necessary for gameplay.
Instructions:
PC Controls:
WASD - Move your character
Space - Jump
Right Mouse Button - Camera control

Mobile Controls:
Joystick - Move your character
Hold your finger on the screen - Camera control

Title: Obby: Mine, Build, Launch
Description:
Dive into a fast, satisfying browser obby where the real goal is simple: mine resources, upgrade everything, and grow your digging empire. Grab your tool, break blocks, collect loot, and turn every run into progress. Improve your base, boost your power, and watch your income climb.

Mine more — upgrade faster:
• Upgrade tools to mine quicker and carry more.
• Upgrade your base to process resources and unlock stronger boosts.
• Hire workers to speed up routine farming while you push for bigger upgrades.

Build your style and your squad:
• Buy cute pets that help you mine and accelerate progress.
• Collect skins to stand out and customize your character.
• Unlock new tools and upgrades to keep your grind smooth and rewarding.
Instructions:
🖥 PC Version (Keyboard & Mouse):
W, A, S, D — move character
Mining/Harvesting — right mouse button (RMB)

📱 Mobile Version (Joystick & Touch):
Movement — joystick
Mining/Harvesting — tap the right side of the screen
